verdict.rationale: Cline's docs say Plan mode lets it read the codebase and run searches on its own without modifying files (cline-docs-39). Subagents can each explore the codebase independently in their own context window and report back to the main agent (cline-docs-25), so exploration does not depend on hand-picked context files. A community comment notes Cline does not index the codebase (cline-comm-2), meaning exploration relies on live reading and searching rather than a prebuilt index; this is a design caveat, not evidence that mapping fails. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of whole-codebase mapping or architecture-explanation output, persistent codebase indexing, and independent hands-on reports of Cline explaining a large unfamiliar repo.
